issues.item: Avoid Religious Spaces: Places of worship or religious gatherings
issues.explanation: The profile omits Triggers and Threat entirely, which is acceptable given the formulation, but the selected Maladaptive Strategies are not coherent with the listed trauma context. Avoiding religious spaces has no clear clinical link to physical abuse by a romantic partner and is unsupported by any trigger, threat, memory, or appraisal content in the rest of the profile.

Mirror checking is difficult to reconcile with the rest of the profile. It implies a specific concern about appearance, injury, or visible threat cues, but no memory or appraisal item references bodily damage, appearance, or checking-related concerns.

issues.item: Memory Detachment: I detach myself from the memories
issues.explanation: Within Maladaptive Strategies, avoiding religious spaces, mirror checking, and memory detachment do not form a coherent strategy cluster for the same patient/trauma. They suggest three unrelated coping patterns without support elsewhere in the profile.

Mirror checking is not well supported by the rest of the profile for physical abuse by a romantic partner. It suggests appearance/surveillance-focused threat or injury monitoring, but there are no corresponding threat, trigger, memory, or appraisal items linking the trauma to mirrors, visible injuries, or being watched, making this strategy clinically hard to place in the formulation.

issues.item: Life Not Worth Living: I am not sure my life is worth living anymore
issues.explanation: 'Life not worth living anymore' is markedly more severe and broad than the rest of the selected items, which otherwise center on shame, self-blame, injustice, vivid replay, and avoidance/detachment. In this profile it stands out as a global suicidal/hopelessness appraisal without supporting threat, memory, or strategy content reflecting comparable pervasive collapse, so it is not well integrated with the rest of the five-component profile.
